launches.title: Trident: Secure your company 24/7
launches.tagline: My app keeps getting hacked what can I do?
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110468&key=user_uploads/2758911/13ca2ba5-d205-4afd-8d7c-ea92334d7136)

**TL;DR**: Traditional pentesting is a thing of the past. Attackers use AI now, so we're making it fair. Trident safely and continuously attacks your own apps and cloud so you know what to fix before they do.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110468&key=user_uploads/2758911/a4001049-62a7-4856-b611-2f692dc8c3b7)

Today we're launching Trident.

AI changed the game on both sides. Your team ships every single hour; attackers scan and exploit at a scale no human team can match. Meanwhile, security is still sold as an annual pentest: a PDF about a version of your product that no longer exists.

That's not a fair fight. So we built Trident to make it even.

Trident safely runs attacks on your own web apps, APIs, and cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes), continuously. Every finding comes as an attack path that actually reaches your data, with proof of exploit and a proper fix. You know what to fix before someone else finds it.\
\
[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qIn0j8LgI3XijoqyE0HBT4G66hBdyCAy](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qIn0j8LgI3XijoqyE0HBT4G66hBdyCAy/view?usp=sharing)

Since our batch started, we've found critical vulns in a ton of startups, bug bounty prorgams and 3 unicorns:

* API keys hardcoded in desktop app binaries (yes, that was us on Twitter)
* Publicly exposed S3 buckets and Azure Blob containers
* Exploitable flaws in live DeFi protocols

All responsibly disclosed and fixed before anyone else got there. And none of these were careless teams, just great ones moving fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110468&key=user_uploads/2758911/bdb88f72-d6d1-44f1-a2d8-4aa555bfa399)

Can't afford a dedicated security team yet? That's exactly who we built this for.

Your job is to ship. Ours is to secure.
